summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to disclose daily repurchase activity under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program, as required by ASX rules. Terms: up to $1 billion in aggregate of Class A and Class B common stock, no price/share stated. Board authorized; no advisor named. Mechanics: open-market repurchases, disclosed post-trade on ASX; no fixed expiration. What to watch: pace of execution and market conditions affecting buyback timing.
